description: Payment service became unavailable 10 minutes after deployment CHG0009900. Customers unable to complete purchases. Error logs show null pointer exception in payment processor.
symptoms: null pointer exception, service unavailable, payment failures
root_cause_notes: New deployment introduced a breaking change in payment processor library version.
resolution_notes: Rolled back deployment CHG0009900 to previous stable version.
work_notes: Checked deployment logs at 09:15. Confirmed null pointer in new library version. Rollback initiated at 10:00.
close_notes: Deployment process to include integration tests for payment processor going forward.
